market_note: Stablecoin market cap has slid to a six-month low near $287B (down ~$16B in 10 weeks) as the GENIUS Act's ban on payment-stablecoin yields pushes capital toward tokenized Treasuries.

stablecoin_items.headline: Tether Launches USAT, Enters US Market Head-On With Circle
stablecoin_items.summary: Tether's new USAT stablecoin, issued via Anchorage Digital Bank under the GENIUS Act framework, marks its first regulated US product and a direct challenge to Circle's USDC dominance.

stablecoin_items.headline: Treasury Proposes GENIUS Act Rules After Missing Deadline
stablecoin_items.summary: US Treasury issued proposed stablecoin issuer rules on Aug 17 after six federal agencies failed to finalize a coordinated package by the July 18 statutory deadline; comment period runs into August.

stablecoin_items.headline: Stablecoin Market Cap Slides to Six-Month Low
stablecoin_items.summary: Total stablecoin market cap fell to roughly $287B, down $16B over 10 weeks, as GENIUS Act's yield ban on payment stablecoins pushes capital into tokenized Treasuries.

hack_items.headline: Coldcard Hardware Wallet Exploit Tops $130M
hack_items.summary: Attackers exploiting a five-year-old firmware flaw in Coinkite's Coldcard wallets have drained over $130M (1,800+ BTC) from 5,200+ addresses across four waves since July 30; Coinkite has pushed emergency patches.

hack_items.headline: macOS Screen-Sharing Flaw Exploited for Covert Monero Mining
hack_items.summary: Hackers abused CVE-2026-65400, a now-patched macOS screen-sharing vulnerability, to remotely hijack Macs with exposed port 5900 and mine Monero without owners' knowledge.

hack_items.headline: H1 2026 Crypto Hack Losses Hit $1.32B
hack_items.summary: Crypto project hacks totaled $1.32B in the first half of 2026; April alone saw over $600M stolen across ~30 incidents, including the $285M Drift and $293M Kelp DAO exploits.
